title: MIDAS Lookup Table Response (v2.0)
description: Response from the ValueData endpoint when queried with LookupTable alone. v2.0 (2026-06-22) replaces the v1.0 bare array of LookupEntry with a keyed object — the table name plus a 'data' array of rows (confirmed against live v2.0, 2026-06-22). Mirrors the RIN-list bare-array-to-keyed-object change.

table_name.description: The name of the lookup table (e.g. 'Unit', 'Ratetype', 'Distribution', 'Energy').

data.description: The rows of the lookup table.
